sources.author: Zdrgon
patch_list: Bypass PairIP application checks

Required for re-signed builds: PairIP's Application class runs the signature and license checks at startup. This rewrites that one method so it only registers the app context and never calls either check, instead of relying on the checks t…
Bypass PairIP license check

Required for re-signed builds: PairIP asks Google Play to license the app at startup and sends non-Play installs to a Play Store block page. Disables that check, its verdict handler, both block-page launchers, the delayed shutdown, and the…
Change installer source
Spoofs the installer source so the app appears to be installed from Google Play everywhere it is read. Pre-selected companion for the DiskWala patch set — keep it on.
Disable ads
Stubs AppLovin, AdMob, InMobi and other ad SDKs at the bytecode level to prevent ads from loading without breaking the app.
Disable forced update
Bypasses PairIP license check ('Download from Play Store'), Play Integrity, and signature verification to allow modified and sideloaded app usage.
Disable PairIP license activity
Required for re-signed builds: removes PairIP's LicenseActivity from the manifest entirely, so the Play Store block page and license error dialog can never be shown, whatever tries to open them.
Enable Premium

Turns on Premium (no ads, real file names, HD downloads, faster streaming) as if subscribed. Keep the pre-selected PairIP bypass patches on — a re-signed build cannot pass PairIP's startup license check without them.
Patch native libraries

Neutralizes PairIP traps in native .so libraries and patches Hermes bundle. Also applies the standalone-install manifest fixes (real Application class, original component factory, native library extraction) and removes the stock baseline p…
Unlock premium
Makes RevenueCat entitlements appear active so ads-free and premium features are unlocked.
